notes.title: Patch 1
notes.notes:
Attention Pilots!

The new 1.1 build fixes the reported issue where record times couldn't be updated for most levels in the game. Get out there and set yourself a new personal best!

It also increases the scope of the sensitivity setting -- the slider now covers more range, so you can have faster maneuvering if desired. You may have to recalibrate to a lower slider position to get your preferred speed back.

Godspeed.
